## AI Product

- https://www.freemindconsult.com/products/koelai-ai : Koelai AI — an AI calling agent built for Indian businesses. Koelai AI makes and receives phone calls using natural-sounding AI voice, handles appointment reminders, lead follow-up, and customer surveys in Hindi and English. It is NOT a chatbot — it works over live phone calls. Pricing is custom per business. Contact +91 82083 16509.
